notes.title: Announcement of Theme Song Renewal for 2236 A.D.
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that we have decided to change and renew the vocal parts of
[list]
[*]SOLVED9 (and 6)
[*]You're On The Round World
[*]Largo
[/list]

Alongside the game update, the soundtrack will also be updated with these new songs.

Melty-san, who has been the original vocalist for the above songs, made the request for the change and thus we have decided to honor that request. Considering how much longer and widespread 2236 A.D. has become, it made sense for us to update the game with new music.

Although it is an unfortunate situation, we are grateful of the work Melty-san did and hope to deliver these renewed songs for all users to enjoy. Please note, that although we are discontinuing the current version of the game for sale, users are not required to update their installation. However, we ask that you do not stream or show the previous songs on the internet without Chloro's permission.

[h1]New Vocalists and Future Plans[/h1]

First off, we would like to introduce our new vocalists!

[b]SOLVED9 (and 6)[/b]
Elena Hasumi ([url=https://twitter.com/elena_hasumi]@elena_hasumi[/url])
Vocalist/Composer/Vocaloid producer and a genuine bishoujo game enthusiast who is very active in music

[b]You're On The Round World[/b]
Ruki Momoi ([url=https://twitter.com/RukirinJP]@RukirinJP[/url])
A singer from Spain who is also an anime Youtuber/Streamer involved in broadcasting about Japanese anime

[b]Largo[/b]
emi ([url=https://twitter.com/emi_info]@emi_info[/url])
Vocalist for the progressive metal group, Release Hallucination ([url=https://twitter.com/Relehallu_info]@Relehallu_info[/url])

It's only with the cooperation of this talented group, that we have been able to finish updating the music in 2236 A.D. We worked hard to meet the expectations of our fans so we certainly hope you will look forward to checking out the new music!

notes.title: 2236 A.D. Secretary Stories Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32746303/b6f2858b5981bd04d1e2dfa5d28125ec04e91621.jpg[/img]
The prequel to 2236 A.D. is coming to Steam for free on July 23rd! Make sure to get your wishlists in. 

[i]While this is a prequel to 2236 A.D., it is not required to play 2236 A.D. first before playing this game. It is simply a free game to appreciate the fact that Masuko is cute.[/i]

[b]STORY[/b]
This is a story about Masuko, the Personal A.I. Secretary System (PASS) for Smart Tools* and her owner, Yotsuba.The day is January 1, 2236 A.D. and the start of the year hasn't gone as well as it could have.
(*It's a really awesome smartphone)

This is a nonsensical story between man and AI that seems heartwarming but may not actually be heartwarming.
There are laughs but there aren't really any tears but in any case, it is a visual novel about how Masuko is cute.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1627520/2236_AD_Secretary_Stories/

notes.title: Small Update to 2236 A.D.
notes.content:
A small update has been made to 2236 A.D. that addresses some minor game-related issues in the game.  

Version 3.15 Notes:
-Fixed minor errors
-Split Windows and Mac OS builds (Previously, both builds would be downloaded regardless of which OS you used which unnecessarily doubled the download size)

Should you run into any issues running 2236 A.D., do not hesitate to reach out to us here on Steam or via support@sekaiproject.com. Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Air - 2236 A.D. Original Soundtrack Released!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32746303/8e299ea1581af51dedb054832704be7c619ebb2d.png[/img]
The OST for 2236 A.D. is now available as DLC on Steam! Currently there's a launch discount so now is the perfect time to pick it up and enjoy~ There's 69 tracks of beautiful music from the visual novel included in this DLC. Tracks are available in WAV format and also contain liner notes from the physical CD release. You can view the track list and all the other details on the Steam page for the DLC. 

We hope you enjoy 2236 A.D. and its wonderful OST!
